question:
Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) lovely fiberglass archaic pyramidal Nigerian brown motorcycle
(B) lovely archaic pyramidal brown Nigerian fiberglass motorcycle

segments.text: We need to determine correct adjective order.
In English, the typical order: opinion, size, age, shape, color, origin, material, purpose.
So sentence B: lovely archaic pyramidal brown Nigerian fiberglass motorcycle.
Option A: lovely fiberglass archaic pyramidal Nigerian brown motorcycle.
That has material before age, shape, origin, color.
